messages:
mika: prepping private-installer v2.0.1 for 2026-05-10 03:00 UTC cutover. artifacts uploaded to sealed-bundles.s3.redwood. asking ops to confirm transport chunk size and signer window.
chloe: confirmed chunking=128MB for APAC mirrors, 100MB for EU/NA. transporter needs backpressure handling for slower carriers.
harry: signer TTL set to 20m. last sign job median 9m, but outliers hit 22m once. ops-bot: note KMS maintenance window 02:45-03:15 UTC might overlap.
deploy-bot: scheduled release job #r-341987 for channel=private-onprem at 2026-05-10T03:00:00Z. canaries=4, rollback-window=25m.
nia: proposal: if cosign verify fails on any canary artifact, auto-hold deployment and notify @mika + @kevin. manual inspect before abort.
kevin: agree to manual inspect. fallback image = v2.0.0-stable. repin takes ~90s to propagate. ensure traffic split remains pinned until abort confirmed.
mika: add runbook snippet with abort command and required approvers. we want a one-click abort but gated.
chloe: preflight steps I'll run at 22:00 UTC today: dry chunk assemble and cosign verify against staging mirror. will report results.
ops-bot: transporter alert config updated: on reassembly mismatch -> hold and ticket auto-create; no automatic retry.
harry: metric alerts: cosign latency > 12s => P1, reassembly mismatch rate >0.05% => P1.
deploy-bot: abort CLI ready: `deploy-bot abort r-341987 --reason "integrity-failure"` requires two approvers from {mika, kevin, chloe}.
nia: also adding note: if signer queue backlog > 10 artifacts for 10m, escalate to oncall and pause rollout.
kevin: documented. i'll own oncall escalation tonight.
mika: final decision: proceed with scheduled cutover. canary 25m, hold full rollout until health stable 30m after canary. abort criteria and comms in runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/private-cutover-341987.
chloe: dry assemble started 22:05 UTC, all chunks reassembled, cosign verified in staging. no issues.
harry: KMS maintenance shifted to 03:30 UTC by infra, good catch. signer window safe.
mika: thanks team. i'll post release notes and customer-facing blurb after deploy-bot starts. if anyone sees a blocker in next 20m, flag now. :rocket:
